items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Ross Andres is made by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Didn't they have any recording facilities at all in New Orleans? No. And then at that time no one in New Orleans was recording? No.
First time I saw a recording outfit and when I recorded for Spike Brothers, Ross Andres.
It was Fred Washington, is the pianist, was he on that date?
